name: Social Responsibility
excerpt: Social responsibility involves benefiting both the firm and greater society.
notes: Social responsibility refers to the obligations of a business to benefit not only the firm but also the greater society. It encompasses the stakeholder view, which includes responsibilities to people, profit, and planet, and encourages philanthropy, sustainability, and ethical behavior.
context_summary:
- Refers to business obligations to benefit society.
- Encompasses responsibilities to people, profit, and planet.
- Encourages philanthropy, sustainability, and ethical behavior.
